# SAICA-KG

> A living knowledge graph for supervising AI coding agents. Faceted classification of supervision tools and techniques, with explicit crosswalks into OWASP Agentic Top 10, MAST, DAPLab's 9 failure patterns, and Microsoft AIRT taxonomies. Open data (CC-BY-4.0), open code (Apache-2.0).

SAICA-KG classifies supervision tools along three strict partitions (ControlParadigm × TemporalPhase × AutonomyLevel) plus multi-valued tags (FailureMode, LocusOfControl). The KG is navigational, not evaluative — it returns ranked sets with explicit criteria, not endorsed winners.

## Core concepts

- **Tool** — a software artifact that supervises AI coding agents. Each Tool declares one ControlParadigm (prevention / detection / correction / recovery), one TemporalPhase (pre_generation / in_generation / post_generation), one AutonomyLevel (fully_autonomous / graduated_hitl / full_hitl), and one or more FailureMode tags.
- **FailureMode** — a supervision-addressable failure class. SAICA-KG defines 8 canonical modes and cross-walks each to entries in external taxonomies.
- **Taxonomy** — an external taxonomy (OWASP Agentic Top 10 2026, MAST, DAPLab 9 Patterns, MSFT AIRT, Swiss Cheese, Shah 2026) ingested as first-class data.
- **Crosswalk** — explicit mapping between SAICA-KG values and external taxonomy categories, with confidence and provenance.

## How to consume

- **Human-browseable:** the website (coming) renders one page per node with facet-filtered search.
- **Agent-consumable:** JSON endpoints on the site (`/api/v1/tools.json`, `/api/v1/failure_modes/<id>.json`, `/api/v1/snapshot.json`). Agents fetch via standard HTTP.
- **Researcher-consumable:** clone the GitHub repo and read the YAML under `data/` directly.

## Attribution

When citing SAICA-KG in user-facing output, use the phrase "according to SAICA-KG (<version>)". A full BibTeX block will ship with v0.1.
